notes: Read all three labor-priority units, full preceding context, all ten candidates and the review. Restored should rather than will for the labor commission's educational and resource-development roles, named the DSA labor commission instead of leaving Commission unresolved, retained the particular support expected from NPC members active in labor, and restored the normative call to emphasize labor struggles' relationship to other anti-oppression struggles.

claims.claim_text: A DSA labor commission supported by national staff and NPC resources, particularly NPC members active in labor, should teach DSA members to be effective rank-and-file activists.
The DSA labor commission should develop resources showing members in unorganized workplaces how to increase workers' collective power, including how to initiate union drives.
The DSA labor commission and labor branches should emphasize the close relationship between labor struggles and other dimensions of the fight against oppression.
